scope: Local real account/admin interaction experiment, not production RUM INP or full T21 acceptance.

methodology.feedback: Trusted click timestamp to earliest visible feedback plus two rAF callbacks; paint proxy, not exact pixel paint or INP.
methodology.completion: Same browser timestamp to actual result state plus two rAF; async network duration separate and has no 200ms business completion budget.
methodology.eventTiming: 16ms observer threshold; 8ms quantized event group max; missing entries are censored, not zero.
methodology.cache: new context per mode, browser cache disabled, production assets gzip; route navigation resets scenario state
methodology.data: 26 real canonical repository sessions per mode plus actual browser login; five revocations, independent mode users; complete standard administrator MFA recovery set.

failure: Actual laboratory measurement did not complete or failed; sanitized diagnostics retained. No private credentials or API bodies are logged.
